game-master.observedBeforeActionResult: At10.5–11.5s Batman steps/pivots on the snow during combat. At12–13s several depressed sole-shaped marks remain exposed in the foreground after feet move onward. At13–15.5s those marks remain while characters/camera move and further marks accumulate. At54–56s a wider snowy floor shows numerous persistent prints and body-contact disturbances around ongoing combat. Snow particles blowing through the air are visually distinct from these ground marks.
claimLimits: The source establishes visible contact trails, not the internal rendering code. Shader/depth/height-map/tessellation claims require the existing primary developer source.
Do not label particles as the footprint mechanism or assume every disturbance is caused only by feet; falling bodies leave broader marks too.
Do not infer a specific persistence duration across rounds from disjoint excerpts. Frame review establishes local visible persistence within10.5–15.5s.
The uploader states max settings and PhysX high; these are uploader descriptions, not independently measured settings.

localDraftUseAssessment.purpose: Critically explain the specific persistent snow-contact appearance in Batman Arkham Origins with original narration and a functioning Unity reconstruction. The excerpt is the observed object of the technical explanation, not generic combat montage.
localDraftUseAssessment.necessity: Earlier sources did not clearly show footprints. Five seconds here show contact and visible aftermath; a separate two-second return is enough to reconnect the explanation to actual output. Both ranges are nonoverlapping and bounded; do not loop, slow down, freeze or add unrelated fights to fill runtime.
localDraftUseAssessment.transformationAndAmount: Independent technical commentary, captions and a short target mark are combined with a separately authored scene. No source audio is adopted. The7s maximum excerpt does not reproduce the full288.338s challenge or its scoring narrative.
localDraftUseAssessment.attribution: crawdad; exact video title and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dHEPF6M761U in KO/EN description credits. Do not assert CC license or endorsement.
localDraftUseAssessment.limits: Specific editorial assessment for local review only; not a legal guarantee, proof of recording/game permission or public clearance. Nonpublic use alone is not an exception. Publication requires separate review of the exact excerpt and rights basis.
